ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black surface with approximately <5% high-intensity white pixel coverage localized at lateral tips and scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid black pigmentation across the majority of the visible surface. High-contrast white contiguous clusters are mapped to the far lateral tips of both lobes. Multiple discrete white circular pixel blobs are scattered across the dorsal-medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression; calculated vertex angle approximately 40 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 18% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration along the entire continuous linear boundary; approximately 15-20 distinct peaks per lobe with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upper boundary sweep on both lobes tapering to sharp, pointed lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast white pixels at the extreme lateral terminals. Approximately 25+ isolated, roughly circular white focal points distributed across the black field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, roughly parallel, horizontal light-grey linear pixel disruptions located in the upper-inner quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe and extensive high-contrast scarring or encrustation at both lateral fluke tips.
